The '''Nuvar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nuvar]].
